lines.en: : The time has come for me to save my family. I will complete my journey and defeat the final boss of Sensei-Quest.
Sensei’s HP has increased to 50!
: That would have been really helpful like four boss fights ago.
With a head full of hopes and dreams, our brave hero sets off toward Meowri’s house.
In the final version of the game, a forty-five minute cutscene depicting his journey will be shown here.
For now, please accept this picture of a binturong.
: What the hell is a binturong?
SENSEIDEX: The binturong, also known as a bearcat, is a carnivorous mammal native to south and southeast Asia. Their status in the wild is currently assessed as “vulnerable.”
: Since when do I have a Senseidex and why is the only entry in it an endangered animal?
SENSEIDEX: Correction — the binturong is not “endangered.” It is currently “vulnerable,” as previously mentioned. Please pay attention, idiot.
: And why is it so rude?

After the forty-five minute walk to Meowri’s house concludes, Sensei knocks on Meowri’s door and prepares himself to leave a survey detailing how he thinks the Shiawase Group can improve Sensei-Quest!
Please note that Sensei will receive 50 RAINBOW COINS for completing this survey!
: But I’ve already passed the point of no return. What am I even supposed to do with those now?
You can use them in new game plus — where all encounters are ten times harder with mild variations.
: Oh god no.
Sensei has arrived at Meowri’s House!
: This is a McDonald’s.
: Hello again, brave hero! Did you enjoy your journey?
: No.
: Really? Why not?
: Probably because like 95%% of enemy attacks dealt the same amount of damage while my attacks needed to be made in an extremely specific order with no logic to it whatsoever.
: The boss health bars never moved, I could never see what my HP or PREMIUM CURRENCY levels were, there were only two vendors and three BGM tracks, and like all of the non-boss enemies were slimes.
: Your feedback has been recorded!
: Please accept these 50 RAINBOW COINS as thanks for playing Sensei-Quest!
: I want all of my time back. No one told me I was going to have to beat an entire RPG just to get on with the Halloween update.
: What’s that? You’re ready to beat the game? Why didn’t you just say so?!
Meowri has removed the Four Orbs of Power from Sensei’s inventory!
: Hey! I worked really hard for those!
: You sure did! But in order to face the final boss, we need to take them to a special location that only I know about and perform a secret summoning ritual.
: Can we not just summon the boss inside this McDonald’s? I’ve been surviving off of Greenis bits for weeks.
: You’ll be able to eat real food once you defeat the final boss!
: And also, if you die, you have to start the whole game all over.
: I have to what?
: Yup! So be really careful to not make any mistakes!
: Or just save the game. That works too, I guess.
: I’m never playing another Shiawase Group game for as long as I live.
: That just means you can play more Sensei-Quest!
: Please, anything but that.
Meowri and Sensei exit Meowri’s house before Meowri transforms into a car!
: Don’t ask questions! Just get in!
Sensei enters Meowri, but in a way that provides no sexual pleasure to him whatsoever!
He takes his place in the middle section of the backseat (which does not have a seatbelt) because he is very daring and brave and also kind of weird.
: I am a force to be reckoned with.
But then Meowri is T-boned by another vehicle and Sensei takes 50 damage!
Sensei has died!
Thanks for playing Sensei-Quest!
: Just a little more...
: Aaaand...
: Done!
: Sensei! Are you still with me?
: Come on! Wake up!
Sensei has revived!
: Meowri?...
: What happened?
: We were in a terrible accident! I had to rewrite the game’s ending just to bring you back.
: How do you feel?
: Like I just died.
: Well, you did just die. But you’re okay now! Or at least...you need to hurry up and get okay. The final boss will be appearing any second now.
Sensei gazes up at Meowri. A small sphere hovers and pulsates several inches above her hands, which are currently clasped together as if to receive the Eucharist.
: What is that thing?
: A new beginning.
It is at that moment that Sensei realizes what the sphere is — the Four Orbs of Power fused together into the Ancient Orb.
: This is the final boss. This is what you must defeat if you ever want to see your family again.
: It’s what you must defeat if you ever want to see anything again.
: There is a dark entity within each and every one of us — and this one is yours.
The sphere begins to rapidly expand in size. Meowri takes a step back as it now hovers on its own, without what little assistance her hands provided before.
: Good luck, hero.
: The final battle begins now!
The Orb appeared!
: I can’t...
: I can’t do it...
The Orb peers deep into Sensei’s soul, but there is no life left in him to drain.
Sensei collapses to the ground, scared and confused.
The Orb does not move. But as Sensei begins to fade away, he can faintly make out the sounds of whispers bleeding from the dark entity’s center.
“Believe...in...God...”
But is that what the whispers are actually commanding? Or is that just what he expects to hear?
In his final moments, he changes everything about himself.
He becomes a better man.
He finally learns what it is that makes the earth move.
But it is too late for belief alone to change anything.
Sensei dies!

Welcome to the first ever special Halloween update in Lessons in Love!
THIS IS WHERE YOU’RE MEANT TO BE.
: Sensei?
: Please tell me that...at least you came here with me...
: Please?...
: Come on! Tell a joke already! No one wants to see whatever this weird sketch is!
: Mind your manners, Misty. Lidearel is clearly new to this game. We must remain kind to her so long as the sprout still hangs above her head.
: Something...seems off.
: What’s wrong, Ayane? You seemed so confident just a minute ago.
: Classic case of stage fright. Same thing happened to me the first time I played the Whisky.
: Just do it like you practiced. I can’t even remember how many times you made us sit through your rehearsal.
: Maybe she just needs a little encouragement? Everybody! Let’s cheer for Ayane and give her the courage she needs to perform her routine!
: A-ya-ne! A-ya-ne! A-ya-ne!
: I want to go home.
: ...and so I said to the cashier, “That’s no St. Bernard! That’s my AK47!” And Sana, I swear, you should have seen the look on her face!
: Something wrong, Maya? You seem super confused all of a sudden. You don’t think somebody spiked your drink, do you?
: That’s weird, I...
: I could have sworn I was going as Haruhi this year...
: Haruhi? From that super old anime?
: It was a light novel first, but...that’s...not really the point.
: You sure you’re not just misremembering? The manga club decided that we were all going to be dress up as Genshin Impact characters this year. And you were, like, really adamant about going as Mona.
: I...was?
: Yeah...are you sure everything’s okay? Do you want to go lie down or something? I can come with you.
: I’ll be...
: Actually...
: Yeah...
: Let’s...go lie down for a minute.
